facts.raw_span: A 66-year-old man with type 2 diabetes
HbA1c 11.2%
one-week history of worsening right hand pain, swelling, and erythema
a concrete bench had fallen on the dorsal base of his right fourth digit without skin break
he noted a bruise at that site
1.5-cm painful, fluctuant mass extending from the palmar web space to the A2 pulley of the fourth digit
focal tenderness over the flexor sheath
limited active digit motion
afebrile
WBC count was 17.5 × 10^9/L
diffuse soft-tissue swelling throughout the palm and into the distal interphalangeal joints of the third and fourth digits
intact bony anatomy and no fracture or dislocation
